name: Failure To Assemble
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of believers assembling together in unity and fellowship, as seen in Psalms 133:1 where dwelling together in harmony is described as good and pleasant. Matthew 18:20 assures the presence of Christ when even a small number gather in His name, underscoring the spiritual significance of assembly. The early church exemplified this commitment by steadfastly continuing in apostles' teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread, and prayer (Acts 2:42, 46). Conversely, Proverbs 18:1 warns against self-isolation driven by personal desires, highlighting the dangers of separating oneself from the community. Ephesians 4:11 reveals that God equips the church with various leaders to build up the body, further affirming the necessity of gathering for mutual growth and edification.
